purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Emurua Dikirr Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 150 DPI directly from a freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved). This particular official upload is a CamScanner phone-photo scan (visible page curvature, binder-hole shadows and a CamScanner footer logo), not a flatbed scan, but the printed table is fully legible; page 1 carries the header confirming EMURUA DIKIRR / code 178 / NAROK / code 033 in standard column order (Odinga, Ruto, Waihiga, Wajackoyah), and page 2 carries the final TOTAL row. The PDF has no embedded text layer beyond a couple of stray characters (confirmed by direct extraction attempt), so all values were read visually from the rendered page image and independently cross-confirmed with a separate 500 DPI crop of the TOTAL row. The printed registered-voters total reconciles exactly to the existing governed 2022 denominator.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image, then independently cross-confirmed with a separately rendered high-DPI crop of the same row (auto-located by green-shading pixel detection, scripts/p23/find_total_row.py). No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.
